description: Search awarded tenders in one country (Postgres), largest amount first, stable paging. Every filter is a property of this schema; country omitted means singapore. A bad value or an unknown argument is an invalid-params error whose data lists every problem (errors[]). Returns {rows, total, page, pageSize}.

agency.description: Buyer slug, or text in the buyer name (substring).

awarded_days.description: Awarded in the last N days (UTC days).

date_days.description: Published or awarded in the last N days (UTC days).

page_size.description: Rows per page, from 1. Default 100; the plan cap and 1,000 apply.

published_days.description: Published in the last N days (UTC days).

year.description: Award year (publication year when the award date is missing).

name: search_awards
title: Search awards in one country
